02365:     private fun copyFileToDestination(
02366:         source: FileItem,
02367:         destPath: String,
02368:         targetName: String,
02369:         context: Context? = null
02370:     ) {
02371:         if (source.size == 0L) {
02372:             uploadRawFileToPath(destPath, ByteArray(0), context)
02373:             _clipboardItem.value = null
02374:             clipboardNodeId = null
02375:             _statusMessage.value = "Copiado exitosamente: $targetName"
02376:             return
02377:         }
02378:
02379:         val progress = TransferProgress(
02380:             fileName = targetName,
02381:             filePath = destPath,
02382:             isUpload = false,
02383:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
02384:             totalBytes = source.size,
02385:             type = TransferType.COPY
02386:         )
02387:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != destPath } + progress
02388:
02389:         val meshId = meshClient.getNodeMeshId(cleanNodeId)
02390:         val serverUrl = meshClient.serverUrl.trimEnd('/')
02391:         val cookieToken = meshClient.userAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
02392:             meshClient.relayAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
02393:                 meshClient.extractRawToken(meshClient.authCookie)
02394:             }
02395:         }
02396:         val sessionCookie = meshClient.authCookie.trim()
02397:
02398:         val copyJob = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
02399:             var tempFile: File? = null
02400:             var httpSuccess = false
02401:
02402:             try {
02403:                 tempFile = try {
02404:                     File.createTempFile("mesh_copy_", ".tmp", context?.cacheDir)
02405:                 } catch (_: Exception) {
02406:                     File.createTempFile("mesh_copy_", ".tmp")
02407:                 }
02408:
02409:                 val client = OkHttpHelper.createClient(meshClient.ignoreSsl)
02410:                 val encodedC = try { URLEncoder.encode(cookieToken, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cookieToken }
02411:                 val encodedM = try { URLEncoder.encode(meshId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { meshId }
02412:                 val encodedN = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanNodeId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanNodeId }
02413:
02414:                 val cleanPath = source.path.removePrefix("/")
02415:                 val encodedF1 = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanPath, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanPath }
02416:                 val encodedF2 = try { URLEncoder.encode(source.path, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { source.path }
02417:
02418:                 var downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF1"
02419:                 var reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
02420:                 if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
02421:
02422:                 var response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
02423:                 if (!response.isSuccessful) {
02424:                     downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF2"
02425:                     reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
02426:                     if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
02427:                     response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
02428:                 }
02429:
02430:                 if (response.isSuccessful && response.body != null) {
02431:                     val body = response.body!!
02432:                     val totalSize = if (body.contentLength() > 0) body.contentLength() else source.size
02433:                     val inputStream = body.byteStream()
02434:
02435:                     FileOutputStream(tempFile).use { output ->
02436:                         val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
02437:                         var received = 0L
02438:                         while (activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
02439:                             val read = inputStream.read(buffer)
02440:                             if (read == -1) break
02441:                             output.write(buffer, 0, read)
02442:                             received += read
02443:
02444:                             val prog = if (totalSize > 0) (received * totalSize) / (totalSize * 2) else received / 2
02445:                             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
02446:                                 if (it.filePath == destPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = prog, totalBytes = totalSize) else it
02447:                             }
02448:                         }
02449:                         output.flush()
02450:                     }
02451:                     httpSuccess = tempFile.length() > 0 || source.size == 0L
02452:                 }
02453:             } catch (e: Exception) {
02454:                 Log.e("MeshFilesCopy", "HTTP copy fetch error: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
02455:             }
02456:
02457:             if (httpSuccess && tempFile != null && tempFile.exists() && activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
02458:                 try {
02459:                     val totalSize = source.size.coerceAtLeast(tempFile.length())
02460:                     val uploadReq = JsonObject().apply {
02461:                         addProperty("action", "upload")
02462:                         addProperty("path", destPath)
02463:                         addProperty("size", tempFile.length())
02464:                     }
02465:                     webSocket?.send(uploadReq.toString())
02466:                     delay(100)
02467:
02468:                     FileInputStream(tempFile).use { input ->
02469:                         val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
02470:                         var uploaded = 0L
02471:                         val fileLen = tempFile.length()
02472:                         while (activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
02473:                             val read = input.read(buffer)
02474:                             if (read == -1) break
02475:                             val chunk = ByteString.of(*buffer.copyOfRange(0, read))
02476:                             webSocket?.send(chunk)
02477:                             uploaded += read
02478:
02479:                             val prog = (totalSize / 2) + if (fileLen > 0) (uploaded * totalSize) / (fileLen * 2) else 0L
